configurationHelp.sourceOverrides: Optional per-direction relative source path; standard source/<slug>-E.png or -W.png takes precedence.
configurationHelp.anchors: Optional E/W [x,y] coordinates in ORIGINAL source pixels, ground/root point. Default is alpha bbox horizontal centre and bottom pixel; requires visual review.
configurationHelp.bodyBounds: Optional E/W [left,top,right,bottom] ORIGINAL source pixels excluding wings/effects, for diagnostic body-size checks only.
configurationHelp.portrait: Required before portrait export: {direction:E,crop:[left,top,right,bottom],reviewed:true}. Crop ORIGINAL source pixels around the face/head, never the whole body. Coordinates are manually reviewed.
configurationHelp.references: Optional per-direction list of {path,role} factual generation inputs. No reference is inferred from the folder contents.
configurationHelp.backgroundPolicy: Optional native-alpha or connected-magenta, auto by default. Connected magenta only removes background touching an edge; no global pink removal.
configurationHelp.sharedScale: Optional non-upscaling common scale override; must fit both directions. Auto uses one scale for the complete E/W silhouette envelope.
configurationHelp.cleanupSmallComponents: User-authorized cleaning: remove only disconnected components <=16 visible pixels with each dimension <=8px. Raw sources retained; removed pixel count and bounds recorded.
